name: Umasi — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Umasi from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Umasi" but are not part of the Umasi entry, which is unchanged.

When a mythic umasi confirms a critical hit against an adjacent Medium or smaller creature with, it can expend one use of mythic power as a swift action to remove a vital organ and consume it, gaining the benefits of death knell as above.

It can use this ability even on a creature not currently at negative hit points; however, on a failed save the creature takes 1d3 Con bleed instead of dying.

Immortal Flesh (Su)
